gameName: The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game core rulebook (Fantasy Flight Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Each player takes a sphere's starter deck and its 3 heroes
steps.note: Leadership 13-27: Aragorn, Gloin, Theodred; Tactics 28-42: Legolas, Gimli, Thalin; Spirit 43-57: Eowyn, Dunhere, Eleanor; Lore 58-72: Glorfindel, Denethor, Beravor

steps.text: Add 1 Gandalf (card 73) to each starter deck
Scenario: Passage Through Mirkwood - quest cards 120-123 + Passage Through Mirkwood, Spiders of Mirkwood and Dol Guldur Orcs encounter cards
Shuffle each player deck and the encounter deck separately (not quest cards, not heroes)
Each player places their heroes and sets their threat tracker to the heroes' total threat cost
Damage, progress and resource tokens in a bank next to the encounter deck
Choose a first player by majority (else random); they take the first player token
Each player draws {n}; one mulligan allowed (shuffle back, draw 6, keep)
Quest cards in order, stage 1A on top, near the encounter deck
Follow any setup instructions on the back of the first quest card before flipping it
